title: HexGen-2: Disaggregated Generative Inference of LLMs in Heterogeneous Environment
technique: max-flow + graph-partition scheduling of PD-disaggregated replicas and parallel plans over heterogeneous GPUs under a price budget

optimized_metrics.evidence: HexGen-2 delivers up to a 2.0x and on average a 1.3x improvement in serving throughput, reduces the average inference latency by 1.5x compared with state-of-the-art systems given the same price budget
given the same price budget, and achieves comparable inference performance with a 30% lower price budget

We assess system performance on inference latency using service level objective (SLO) attainment, which gauges the proportion (e.g., 99%) of requests fulfilled within a time frame predefined by the SLO.

headline_claim.text: HexGen-2 delivers up to a 2.0x and on average a 1.3x improvement in serving throughput, reduces the average inference latency by 1.5x compared with state-of-the-art systems given the same price budget, and achieves comparable inference performance with a 30% lower price budget.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Throughput refers to the number of tokens a system can generate within a specified time period.
metric_definitions.notes: generated tokens only; offline eval reports 'average decoding throughput'

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Inference latency is the time required to complete each inference request from start to finish.
This SLO is adjusted to various multiples of single device execution latency (termed as SLO scale) to measure performance under different degrees of SLO stringency.

slo_spec: deadline = multiple of single-device execution latency (SLO scale 1-5); attainment curve (e.g. 99% example)
load_regime: offline (arrival saturating cluster, 4 workload types HPLD/HPHD/LPHD/LPLD) and online (arrival rate = 75% of cluster peak throughput, Azure Conversation samples)
hardware: heterogeneous H100/A100/L40/A6000 GPUs under fixed price budget (cloud)
extractor_notes: The scheduler's internal objective is maximizing system throughput (max-flow = requests per period T) under a price budget; latency is only used to choose prefill parallel plans (latency-optimal) and in the SLO-attainment evaluation. Ambiguous whether latency is an objective or just reported.
